name: The Dabney

menus.name: Five-course prix fixe menu
menus.note: Snacks, a starter, a mid course, a family-style main and dessert; classic wine pairing $95, reserve pairing $165. Supplements include crab (+$15) and lobster (+$6).

alsoTry.name: The Dabney's à la carte menu
alsoTry.note: Served in the dining room, at the bar and on the patio: small plates $16–52, family-style mains for sharing $89–116.

alsoTry.name: The Cellar
alsoTry.note: The Dabney's casual cocktail and wine bar beneath the dining room, with oysters and seafood small plates.

walkIns: The bar is first come, first served and serves the à la carte menu, as do the bar-area tables and the garden patio.
groups: Private events by email (info@thedabney.com). The Cellar, the wine and cocktail bar downstairs, takes private parties of up to 45.
